description.p: Super Dodge Ball for the NES, recompiled: the game's 6502 code is translated ahead of time into native code and run cycle-accurately, with the picture, sound and music the original cartridge produces.
The game needs no ROM to install, but it needs one to play: the launcher asks for your own copy of Super Dodge Ball (USA) at first launch and verifies it. No ROM is bundled.

This port also adds three optional enhancements, all off by default: removal of the game's own sprite flicker, a widescreen presentation that reveals the columns the NES could not show, and PPU overclocking.
